title: Vampire Vape Blood Sukka Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Brace yourself for an e-liquid that packs one ferocious bite! Vampire Vape’s Blood Sukka is an enchanting potion that melds luscious cherries, berries, and red fruits with a hint of sweet eucalyptus, intensified by a bold undercurrent of aniseed and menthol. Blood Sukka's delectable harmony of flavours weaves a spellbinding tapestry, leaving you captivated and craving more. Embrace the intensity of Blood Sukka, a fiercely flavoursome infusion that's not for the faint of heart. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
